description: Blind the suspicious-Windows-path safety check (jtH successor): every detection input found in the 2.1.228 pools is neutralized — device-name regexes (two module copies), three-dots regex, trailing-space and 8.3 short-name regexes become never-matching patterns, and the \\?\ / \\.\ / //?/ / //./ long-path prefix literals become impossible byte sequences. With no input able to match, the check cannot flag paths.
